commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
Even if others do you cruel things that should never be done, it is good to grieve for the suffering this will bring them and to do nothing unrighteous yourself. That grief is pity, that they may fall into the fires of hell.

நோ நொந்து can be your own pain, as the plain reading takes it. He makes it grief for the wrongdoers, for what they will suffer.
